title: Pip and the Red Kite
note: Placeholder story for testing. Step 5 replaces this with your stories.json.

beats.narration: Pip the little fox lived at the edge of a quiet green forest. One windy morning, Pip saw something red flying high in the sky. It was a kite!
beats.prompt: Can you say the word kite?

beats.narration: Whoosh! The wind blew, and the kite got stuck in the branches of a tall oak tree. Pip looked up. The tree was very, very tall.
beats.prompt: What do you think Pip should do?

beats.narration: Pip's heart went thump, thump, thump. The tree was so tall! Pip took a big, slow breath.
beats.prompt: Pip wants to feel brave. Can you say brave?

beats.narration: Step by step, Pip went up the tree. Up, up, up! Pip reached out a paw and held the kite string.
beats.prompt: Pip is going up the tree. Can you say climb?

beats.narration: At the bottom of the tree, a small rabbit was waiting. That is my kite, said the rabbit. Thank you, Pip!
beats.prompt: How do you think the rabbit feels?

beats.narration: Pip and the rabbit flew the kite together all afternoon. They laughed and ran in the sunshine.
beats.prompt: Pip made a new friend. Can you say friend?
